newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at mostly steady levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded, the same as Friday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, this week, no bid, offered at 110 percent of tariff, no comparison.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid at a steady 115 percent, no offer.
- Eight barges, Illinois, two each week July, offered five points higher at 115 percent, no bid.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week September, offered at a steady 175 percent, no bid.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi, one each week October, offered at a steady 245 percent, no bid.
- Four barges, Illinois, offered at a steady 240 percent, no bid.
- Five barges, Illinois, offered at a steady 185 percent, no bid.
